settings.title: Settings
settings.checkUpdatesHelp: Looks for a new release shortly after start and once a day. Nothing is downloaded until you choose to install.
settings.contactHelp: Optional. Added to the User-Agent so GGG can reach you if something misbehaves.
settings.backendHelp: Leave on automatic unless diagnostics recommends otherwise. Takes effect after a restart.
settings.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
settings.convertPricesHelp: Fetches currency rates from poe2scout so listings in exalted, chaos and divine count together and each shows its divine or exalted value.
settings.rememberFilters: Remember stat choices per item type
settings.rememberFiltersHelp: The next ring, bow and so on starts with the stats you had on or off when you last searched one.

hotkeys.help: Click a shortcut, then press the new key combination. Esc cancels, Clear removes it. Pressing a shortcut again closes the window it opened.
hotkeys.needsModifier: Add Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Meta (only F-keys work alone).
hotkeys.advancedCopyHelp: Uses Ctrl+Alt+C so mod tiers and ranges are available.

validation.email: Enter a valid e-mail address or leave it empty.
validation.league: Choose a league or turn on automatic detection.
validation.autoHide: Enter a whole number between 0 and 10000 (0 disables auto-hide).
validation.hotkeyClash: This shortcut is already used by another action.

guidance.accessibility: macOS: open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility and enable RKL. This is needed for hotkeys and copying items.
guidance.screenRecording: macOS: open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording and enable RKL so it can find the game window. Restart RKL afterwards.
guidance.wayland: Wayland-native mode: global hotkeys go through the desktop portal, the overlay is anchored to the output rather than the game window, and keystroke injection may be unavailable. Use X11/XWayland if your compositor allows it.
guidance.gnome: GNOME does not support the Wayland features RKL needs, so it runs through XWayland (X11) there. Run the game under XWayland too.

onboarding.title: Set up RKL
onboarding.intro: A few platform-specific steps so price checks work smoothly. You can come back here any time from Diagnostics.
onboarding.relaunch: macOS applies this permission after RKL restarts. Quit and reopen RKL once you've enabled it.
onboarding.blockedHint: Some required permissions are still missing. RKL will keep working with reduced features.

accessibility.name: Accessibility
accessibility.body: RKL presses the game's copy shortcut for you when you hit the price-check hotkey. macOS requires Accessibility access for that.

screen_recording.name: Screen Recording
screen_recording.body: Lets RKL read window titles so it can find the Path of Exile 2 window reliably. RKL never captures your screen.

input_monitoring.name: Input Monitoring
input_monitoring.body: Lets RKL close the overlay with Esc and react to Ctrl+scroll while the game has focus.

windows.windowedBody: The overlay can't appear above exclusive fullscreen. In the game's graphics options pick Windowed or Windowed Fullscreen (borderless).
windows.elevatedBody: Windows blocks hotkeys and simulated keystrokes from a normal app to an elevated one (UIPI). If the game runs as administrator, run RKL as administrator too.

x11.title: No extra setup needed
x11.body: X11 supports everything RKL needs: global hotkeys, window tracking and an overlay above the game.

gnome.title: GNOME: X11/XWayland only
gnome.x11Body: GNOME lacks the Wayland features RKL needs, so RKL runs through XWayland here. Run the game under XWayland too (the default for Proton and Wine).
gnome.waylandBody: GNOME has no layer-shell, so in Wayland-native mode the overlay can't stay above the game. Switch the backend to X11 / XWayland in Settings.

wayland.degradedBody: Wayland keeps apps isolated from each other, so some features work differently:
wayland.portal: Global hotkeys go through the desktop's GlobalShortcuts portal, which asks you to confirm them. Not every compositor offers it.
wayland.layerShell: The overlay is anchored to the screen edge with layer-shell instead of following the game window.
wayland.noTracking: RKL can't see the game window or listen for Esc, so close the overlay with its own button.
wayland.triggerTitle: Bind the price check in your compositor
wayland.triggerBody: If hotkeys don't work, add a keyboard shortcut in your compositor that runs RKL --trigger. It price-checks the item under the cursor in the running RKL.
wayland.pinnedHint: Add --pinned to open the overlay pinned.

proton.title: Proton mouse capture
proton.body: Under Proton, fullscreen Path of Exile 2 captures the mouse, so clicks and keys never reach RKL's panel. Turning off Wine's mouse capture for the game fixes this; the cursor is then no longer locked to the game window.
proton.quitGame: Quit Path of Exile 2 first: Wine rewrites its settings when the game exits.
proton.restartGame: Done. Start Path of Exile 2 again for the change to take effect.
